slides.headline: The kill switch that could stop AI gone wrong
California governor wants mandatory AI off buttons
slides.body: Newsom backs bill requiring companies to build shutdown controls into powerful AI systems

slides.headline: Applies to AI that could cause mass harm
slides.body: Targets models capable of cyberattacks, bioweapons, or financial crashes — not chatbots

slides.headline: Tech firms say it breaks their products
slides.body: Google, Meta argue kill switches make AI unreliable and slow down safety research

slides.headline: First US law with teeth on AI control
slides.body: If passed, California sets the standard other states and countries will copy

slides.headline: Should AI have an off switch?
slides.body: Follow for AI news that affects your safety, not just your code
